name: Magpie
description: Magpie is x402-native, permissionless agent lending on Solana. Over HTTP 402 pay-per-call (no signup, no API key, zero custody), an autonomous agent borrows SOL against its own memecoin or tokenized-stock/RWA collateral across 170+ tokens, arms self-owned in-vault take-profit and stop-loss exits, and repays with borrower-signed transactions. The @magpieloans/magpie-agent SDK and @magpieloans/magpie-mcp tools sign locally so the service never holds keys.
